name: Flask of Vintage Gorogna
text: Once per battle, in any hero phase, heal the general for D6.

name: There's No Reward Without Risk
text: Once per battle, when a unit wholly within 12" of the general is declared to charge, you can re-roll its charge roll.

name: Leave No Duardin Behind
text: Once per battle, in your hero phase, pick an Arkanaut Company wholly within 12" of the general and roll a dice for each of its slain models. Each 4+ returns one slain model.
